title: NEXY-IGNIS full-fidelity document re-architecture
scope: Re-architect the command-locked NEXY-IGNIS DOCX without changing unique semantics; create DOCX, audit, traceability, atom ledger, and conflict/version registry.
inputs_summary: ข้อความที่วาง (1).txt — FULL-FIDELITY-DOCUMENT-REARCHITECTURE-V1
แอป [NEXY-IGNIS] ที่กำลังพัฒนา(1).docx
actions: Verified source SHA-256 against locked expected hash.
Created 10,979 conservative semantic atoms from all non-empty body paragraphs.
Preserved 10,638 atoms verbatim and consolidated 341 atoms only through verified exact repeated paragraph blocks.
Created 10 conflict/version registry records; 6 remain unresolved and preserved.
Re-read generated DOCX; reverse source-support check passed.
Rendered and visually inspected all 198 pages.
Canonical re-render was pixel-identical for 198/198 pages.
changes: Created new artifacts only; original source was not overwritten.
successes: Full mapped coverage achieved without semantic near-duplicate merging or source guessing.
failures: Initial user-visible Python validation pass hit a time limit while repeatedly indexing python-docx paragraph proxies; recovered by using already-generated artifacts plus linear/container validation and canonical render verification.
decisions: One non-empty source body paragraph = one conservative atom.
No semantic near-duplicate merges were performed.
Source U+FFFD replacement characters were preserved verbatim and treated as ambiguous source glyphs.
DOC-C values govern build scope only where source explicitly says build obligation comes from DOC-C.
unresolved: 6 source conflicts remain UNRESOLVED_SOURCE_CONFLICT by design; variants are preserved.
274 U+FFFD replacement glyphs are literal source corruption/ambiguity and were not guessed.
risks: Consumers must consult conflict registry; unresolved variants must not be silently normalized.
limits: Traceability granularity is conservative paragraph-level semantic atoms, not inferred sub-paragraph atoms.
rollback: Delete generated artifacts/AI-CONTEXT records; source DOCX remains unchanged.
next_actions: Use the re-architected DOCX plus traceability/conflict registry as a cleaner reading layer; do not treat unresolved conflicts as resolved.
